72template <bool Enabled, class Storage, template <class> class CritSec>
73struct value_bitmask_field {
74 CritSec<Storage> bits{};
75
76 [[nodiscard]] bool test(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
77 const auto bval = bits.load();
78 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(i >= sizeof(Storage) * 8)) return false;
79 return (bval >> i) & 1U;
80 }
81 void set(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
82 bits = static_cast<Storage>(bits.load() | (Storage{1} << i));
83 }
84 void clear(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
85 bits = static_cast<Storage>(bits.load() & ~(Storage{1} << i));
86 }
88 void remove_at(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
89 const Storage bval = bits.load();
90 const auto above =
91 static_cast<Storage>(bval >> static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1));
92 const auto below = static_cast<Storage>(bval & ((Storage{1} << i) - 1));
93 bits = static_cast<Storage>(below | (above << i));
94 }
97 void insert_at(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
98 const Storage bval = bits.load();
99 const auto above = static_cast<Storage>(bval >> i);
100 const auto below = static_cast<Storage>(bval & ((Storage{1} << i) - 1));
101 bits =
102 static_cast<Storage>(below | (above << static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1)));
103 }
104};
105
107template <bool Enabled, class T, std::size_t N, template <class> class CritSec>
108struct value_bitmask_field<Enabled, std::array<T, N>, CritSec> {
109 std::array<CritSec<T>, N> bits{};
110
111 [[nodiscard]] bool test(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
112 const T byte_val = bits[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8].load();
113 return (static_cast<unsigned>(byte_val) >>
114 (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)) &
115 1U;
116 }
117 void set(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
118 const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8;
119 bits[idx] = static_cast<T>(bits[idx].load() |
120 (T{1} << (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)));
121 }
122 void clear(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
123 const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8;
124 bits[idx] = static_cast<T>(bits[idx].load() &
125 ~(T{1} << (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)));
126 }
127};

172template <class ArtPolicy>
173struct bulk_subtree_guard {
174 using db_type = typename ArtPolicy::db_type;
175 using node_ptr = typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr;
176
177 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_;
178 node_ptr ptr{nullptr};
179 bool is_packed_value{false};
180
181 constexpr explicit bulk_subtree_guard(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db
182 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
183 : db_{db} {}
184
185 ~bulk_subtree_guard() noexcept {
186 if (ptr != nullptr && !is_packed_value) {
187 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(ptr, db_);
188 }
189 }
190
191 void release() noexcept { ptr = nullptr; }
192
193 bulk_subtree_guard(const bulk_subtree_guard&) = delete;
194 // LCOV_EXCL_START — move ctor only called on vector reallocation
195 bulk_subtree_guard(bulk_subtree_guard&& other) noexcept
196 : db_{other.db_},
197 ptr{std::exchange(other.ptr, nullptr)},
198 is_packed_value{other.is_packed_value} {}
199 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
200 auto& operator=(const bulk_subtree_guard&) = delete;
201 auto& operator=(bulk_subtree_guard&&) = delete;
202};

268//
269// TODO(thompsonbry) Partial or no key in leaf. Once we template for the Value
270// type, we can optimize for u64 or smaller values, the leaf should be replaced
271// by the use of a variant {Value,node_ptr} entry in the inode along with a bit
272// mask to indicate for each position whether it is a leaf or a node. This
273// provides a significant optimization for secondary index use cases (tree
274// height is reduced by one, no small allocations for leaves, the key is no
275// longer explicitly stored, the key size is no longer stored, the value size is
276// no longer stored, etc.). However, we would still need to allocate a leaf for
277// the case where Value is a std::span. But this becomes a simple immutable
278// data structure which exists solely to wrap the Value.
279template <class Key, class Header>
280class [[nodiscard]] basic_leaf final : public Header {
281 public:
284 using key_size_type = unodb::key_size_type;
285
288 using value_size_type = unodb::value_size_type;
289
291 static constexpr std::size_t max_key_size =
292 std::numeric_limits<key_size_type>::max();
293
295 static constexpr std::size_t max_value_size =
296 std::numeric_limits<value_size_type>::max();
297
299 using art_key_type = basic_art_key<Key>;
300
301 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26485)
302
303 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26481)
308 constexpr basic_leaf(art_key_type k, value_view v) noexcept
309 : key_size{static_cast<key_size_type>(k.size())},
310 value_size{static_cast<value_size_type>(v.size())} {
311 // Note: Runtime checks are handled upstream of this by
312 // make_db_leaf_ptr().
313 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(k.size() <= max_key_size);
314 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(v.size() <= max_value_size);
315
316 const auto tmp{k.get_key_view()};
317 std::memcpy(data, tmp.data(), key_size); // store encoded key
318 if (!v.empty()) std::memcpy(data + key_size, v.data(), value_size);
319 }
320 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
321
322
325 //
326 // TODO(thompsonbry) : Partial or no key in leaf?
327 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto get_key() const noexcept {
328 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Key, key_view>) {
329 return art_key_type{get_key_view()};
330 } else {
331 // Use memcpy since alignment is not guaranteed because the
332 // [key] is not an explicit part of the leaf data structure.
333 //
334 // TODO(thompsonbry) memory align leaf::data[0] to 8 bytes?
335 Key u{};
336 std::memcpy(&u, data, sizeof(u));
337 // Note: The encoded key is stored in the leaf. Since the
338 // art_key constructor encodes the key, we need to decode the
339 // key before calling the constructor.
340 return art_key_type{bswap(u)};
341 }
342 }

349 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto get_key_view() const noexcept {

360 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto matches(

371 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto cmp(art_key_type k) const noexcept {

376 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26485)

586template <typename Key, typename Value, template <typename, typename> class Db>
587[[nodiscard]] auto make_db_leaf_ptr(
588 basic_art_key<Key> k, Value v,
589 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST Db<Key, Value>& db UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) {
590 using db_type = Db<Key, Value>;
591 using header_type = typename db_type::header_type;
592 using leaf_type = basic_leaf<leaf_key_type<Key, Value>, header_type>;
593
594 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value> &&
595 std::is_same_v<Key, key_view>) {
596 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(k.size() > leaf_type::max_key_size)) {
597 throw std::length_error("Key length must fit in std::uint32_t");
598 }
599 }
600
601 // Serialize value to bytes for leaf storage.
602 value_view leaf_val_bytes;
603 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26496)
604 [[maybe_unused]] std::byte val_buf[sizeof(Value)]{};
605 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
606 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Value, value_view>) {
607 leaf_val_bytes = v;
608 } else {
609 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Value>);
610 std::memcpy(val_buf, &v, sizeof(v));
611 leaf_val_bytes = value_view{val_buf, sizeof(v)};
612 }
613
614 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes() >
615 leaf_type::max_value_size)) {
616 throw std::length_error("Value length must fit in std::uint32_t");
617 }
618
619 std::size_t size;
620 if constexpr (can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>) {
621 size = leaf_type::compute_size(
622 static_cast<typename leaf_type::value_size_type>(
623 leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes()));
624 } else {
625 size = leaf_type::compute_size(
626 static_cast<typename leaf_type::key_size_type>(k.size()),
627 static_cast<typename leaf_type::value_size_type>(
628 leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes()));
629 }
630
631 auto* const leaf_mem = static_cast<std::byte*>(db.get_allocator().alloc(
632 size, alignment_for_new<leaf_type>(), db.get_allocator().ctx));
633
634#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
635 db.increment_leaf_count(size);
636#endif // UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
637
638 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26402)
639 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26400)
640 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26496)
641 auto* const leaf = [&]() noexcept {
642 if constexpr (can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>) {
643 return new (leaf_mem) leaf_type{leaf_val_bytes};
644 } else {
645 return new (leaf_mem) leaf_type{k, leaf_val_bytes};
646 }
647 }();
648 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
649 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
650 return basic_db_leaf_unique_ptr<Key, Value, header_type, Db>{
651 leaf, basic_db_leaf_deleter<db_type>{db}};
652 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
653}

801 static constexpr bool can_eliminate_leaf =

807 static_assert(can_eliminate_leaf);

1032 struct delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit final {
1034 constexpr explicit delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(
1035 NodePtr node_ptr_ UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND,
1036 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_
1037 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
1038 : node_ptr{node_ptr_}, db{db_} {}
1039
1041 // MSVC C26815 false positive: the destructor creates unique_ptrs whose
1042 // deleters hold references to db. These are immediately destroyed while db
1043 // (a member reference) is still valid - the constructor's LIFETIMEBOUND
1044 // guarantees the referent outlives this object.
1045 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
1046 ~delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit() noexcept {
1047 switch (node_ptr.type()) {
1048 case node_type::LEAF: {
1049 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_leaf) {
1050 const auto r{
1051 make_db_leaf_ptr(node_ptr.template ptr<leaf_type*>(), db)};
1052 }
1053 return;
1054 }
1055 case node_type::I4: {
1056 // cppcheck-suppress throwInNoexceptFunction
1057 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1058 node_ptr.template ptr<inode4_type*>(), db)};
1059 return;
1060 }
1061 case node_type::I16: {
1062 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1063 node_ptr.template ptr<inode16_type*>(), db)};
1064 return;
1065 }
1066 case node_type::I48: {
1067 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1068 node_ptr.template ptr<inode48_type*>(), db)};
1069 return;
1070 }
1071 case node_type::I256: {
1072 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1073 node_ptr.template ptr<inode256_type*>(), db)};
1074 return;
1075 }
1076 }
1077 UNODB_DETAIL_CANNOT_HAPPEN(); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
1078 }
1079 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
1080
1081
1082 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(const delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&) =
1083 delete;
1084
1086 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&&) =
1087 delete;
1088
1090 auto& operator=(const delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&) = delete;
1091
1093 auto& operator=(delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&&) = delete;
1094
1095 private:
1097 const NodePtr node_ptr;
1098
1100 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db;
1101 };

1111 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db
1112 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
1113 : node_{node}, db_{db} {}

1138 static void delete_subtree(
1139 NodePtr node, UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
1140 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit delete_on_scope_exit{node, db_instance};
1141
1142 switch (node.type()) {
1143 case node_type::LEAF:
1144 return;
1145 case node_type::I4: {
1146 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode4_type*>()};
1147 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1148 return;
1149 }
1150 case node_type::I16: {
1151 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode16_type*>()};
1152 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1153 return;
1154 }
1155 case node_type::I48: {
1156 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode48_type*>()};
1157 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1158 return;
1159 }
1160 case node_type::I256: {
1161 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode256_type*>()};
1162 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1163 return;
1164 }
1165 }
1166 }

1173 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE static void dump_node(
1174 std::ostream& os, const NodePtr& node, bool recursive = true) {
1175 os << "node at: " << node.template ptr<void*>() << ", tagged ptr = 0x"
1176 << std::hex << node.raw_val() << std::dec;
1177 if (node == nullptr) {
1178 os << '\n';
1179 return;
1180 }
1181 os << ", type = ";
1182 switch (node.type()) {
1183 case node_type::LEAF:
1184 os << "LEAF";
1185 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_leaf) {
1186 node.template ptr<leaf_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1187 }
1188 break;
1189 case node_type::I4:
1190 os << "I4";
1191 node.template ptr<inode4_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1192 break;
1193 case node_type::I16:
1194 os << "I16";
1195 node.template ptr<inode16_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1196 break;
1197 case node_type::I48:
1198 os << "I48";
1199 node.template ptr<inode48_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1200 break;
1201 case node_type::I256:
1202 os << "I256";
1203 node.template ptr<inode256_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1204 break;
1205 }
1206 }

1225union [[nodiscard]] key_prefix_snapshot {
1226 // TODO(thompsonbry) Can this be replaced by [using
1227 // key_prefix_snapshot = key_prefix<std::uint64_t,
1228 // in_fake_critical_section>]? We need the snapshot to be
1229 // atomic. Does that work with this using decl? [it does not work
1230 // trivially.]
1231 private:
1233 using key_prefix_data = std::array<std::byte, key_prefix_capacity>;
1234
1236 struct [[nodiscard]] inode_fields {
1238 key_prefix_data key_prefix;
1240 key_prefix_size key_prefix_length{};
1241 };
1242
1244 inode_fields f;
1246 std::uint64_t u64;
1247
1248 public:
1252 constexpr explicit key_prefix_snapshot(std::uint64_t v) noexcept : u64(v) {}
1253
1257 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_view get_key_view() const noexcept {
1258 return key_view(f.key_prefix.data(), f.key_prefix_length);
1259 }
1260
1264 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_size length() const noexcept {
1265 return f.key_prefix_length;
1266 }
1267
1275 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1276 std::uint64_t shifted_key_u64) const noexcept {
1277 return shared_len(shifted_key_u64, u64, length());
1278 }
1279
1284 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept {
1285 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < length());

1288
1295 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr unsigned shared_len(
1296 std::uint64_t k1, std::uint64_t k2, unsigned clamp_byte_pos) noexcept {
1297 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(clamp_byte_pos < 8);
1298
1299 const auto diff = k1 ^ k2;
1300 const auto clamped = diff | (1ULL << (clamp_byte_pos * 8U));
1301 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(clamped) >> 3U);
1302 }
1303}; // class key_prefix_snapshot

1313template <typename ArtKey, template <class> class CriticalSectionPolicy>
1314union [[nodiscard]] key_prefix {
1315 private:
1317 template <typename T>
1318 using critical_section_policy = CriticalSectionPolicy<T>;
1319
1321 using key_prefix_data =
1322 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, key_prefix_capacity>;
1323
1325 struct [[nodiscard]] inode_fields {
1327 key_prefix_data key_prefix;
1329 critical_section_policy<key_prefix_size> key_prefix_length;
1330 };
1331
1333 inode_fields f;
1335 critical_section_policy<std::uint64_t> u64;
1336
1337 public:
1343 key_prefix(key_view k1, ArtKey shifted_k2, tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept
1344 : u64{make_u64(k1, shifted_k2, depth)} {}
1345
1347 key_prefix(detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, key_view k1,
1348 tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept
1349 : u64{make_u64_explicit(prefix_len, k1, depth)} {}
1350
1355 key_prefix(unsigned key_prefix_len,
1356 const key_prefix& source_key_prefix) noexcept
1357 : u64{(source_key_prefix.u64 & key_bytes_mask) |
1358 length_to_word(key_prefix_len)} {
1359 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key_prefix_len <= key_prefix_capacity);
1360 }
1361
1363 key_prefix(const key_prefix& other) noexcept : u64{other.u64.load()} {}
1364
1366 ~key_prefix() noexcept = default;
1367
1372 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1373 ArtKey shifted_key) const noexcept {
1374 return get_shared_length(shifted_key.get_u64());
1375 }
1376
1381 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1382 std::uint64_t shifted_key_u64) const noexcept {
1383 return shared_len(shifted_key_u64, u64, length());
1384 }
1385
1392 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_snapshot get_snapshot() const noexcept {
1393 return key_prefix_snapshot(u64);
1394 }
1395
1399 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_size length() const noexcept {
1400 const auto result = f.key_prefix_length.load();
1401 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(result <= key_prefix_capacity);
1402 return result;
1403 }
1404
1408 constexpr void cut(key_prefix_size cut_len) noexcept {
1409 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(cut_len > 0);
1410 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(cut_len <= length());
1411
1412 u64 = ((u64 >> (cut_len * 8)) & key_bytes_mask) |
1413 length_to_word(static_cast<key_prefix_size>(length() - cut_len));
1414
1415 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(f.key_prefix_length.load() <= key_prefix_capacity);
1416 }
1417
1424 constexpr void prepend(const key_prefix& prefix1,
1425 std::byte prefix2) noexcept {
1426 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(length() + prefix1.length() < key_prefix_capacity);
1427
1428 const auto prefix1_bit_length = prefix1.length() * 8U;
1429 const auto prefix1_mask = (1ULL << prefix1_bit_length) - 1;
1430 const auto prefix3_bit_length = length() * 8U;
1431 const auto prefix3_mask = (1ULL << prefix3_bit_length) - 1;
1432 const auto prefix3 = u64 & prefix3_mask;
1433 const auto shifted_prefix3 = prefix3 << (prefix1_bit_length + 8U);
1434 const auto shifted_prefix2 = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(prefix2)
1435 << prefix1_bit_length;
1436 const auto masked_prefix1 = prefix1.u64 & prefix1_mask;
1437
1438 u64 = shifted_prefix3 | shifted_prefix2 | masked_prefix1 |
1439 length_to_word(length() + prefix1.length() + 1U);
1440
1441 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(f.key_prefix_length.load() <= key_prefix_capacity);
1442 }
1443
1448 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept {
1449 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < length());
1450 return f.key_prefix[i].load();
1451 }
1452
1456 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os) const {
1457 const auto len = length();
1458 os << ", prefix(" << len << ")";
1459 if (len > 0) {
1460 os << ": 0x";
1461 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) dump_byte(os, f.key_prefix[i]);
1462 }
1463 }
1464
1466 key_prefix(key_prefix&&) = delete;
1467
1469 key_prefix& operator=(const key_prefix&) = delete;
1470
1472 key_prefix& operator=(key_prefix&&) = delete;
1473
1474 private:
1476 static constexpr auto key_bytes_mask = 0x00FF'FFFF'FFFF'FFFFULL;
1477
1479 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t length_to_word(
1480 unsigned length) {
1481 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(length <= key_prefix_capacity);
1482 return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(length) << 56U;
1483 }
1484
1486 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr unsigned shared_len(
1487 std::uint64_t k1, std::uint64_t k2, unsigned clamp_byte_pos) noexcept {
1488 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(clamp_byte_pos < 8);
1489
1490 const auto diff = k1 ^ k2;
1491 const auto clamped = diff | (1ULL << (clamp_byte_pos * 8U));
1492 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(clamped) >> 3U);
1493 }
1494
1502 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t make_u64(
1503 key_view k1, ArtKey shifted_k2, tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept {
1504 k1 = k1.subspan(depth); // shift_right(depth)
1505
1506 const auto k1_u64 = get_u64(k1) & key_bytes_mask;
1507
1508 return k1_u64 | length_to_word(shared_len(k1_u64, shifted_k2.get_u64(),
1509 key_prefix_capacity));
1510 }
1511
1513 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t make_u64_explicit(
1514 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, key_view k1,
1515 tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept {
1516 k1 = k1.subspan(depth);
1517 const auto k1_u64 = get_u64(k1) & key_bytes_mask;
1518 return k1_u64 | length_to_word(prefix_len);
1519 }
1520}; // class key_prefix

2450 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool can_collapse(
2451 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) const noexcept {
2452 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->is_min_size());
2453 const std::uint8_t child_to_leave = (child_to_delete == 0) ? 1U : 0U;
2454 const auto child_ptr = children[child_to_leave].load();
2455 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2456 if (is_value_in_slot(child_to_leave)) return false;
2457 }
2458 if (child_ptr.type() == node_type::LEAF) {
2459 // For keyless leaves, collapsing would lose key bytes encoded
2460 // in this inode's prefix+dispatch. Keep the chain intact.
2461 return !ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_key_in_leaf;
2462 }
2463 const auto* const child_inode{child_ptr.template ptr<inode_type*>()};
2464 return this->get_key_prefix().length() +
2465 child_inode->get_key_prefix().length() <
2466 detail::key_prefix_capacity;
2467 }

2503 template <typename LeafPtr>
2504 constexpr void init(node_ptr source_node, unsigned shared_prefix_len,
2505 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth, LeafPtr&& child1,
2506 std::byte child1_key_byte) {
2507 auto* const source_inode{source_node.template ptr<inode_type*>()};
2508 auto& source_key_prefix = source_inode->get_key_prefix();
2509 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(shared_prefix_len < source_key_prefix.length());
2510
2511 const auto source_node_key_byte = source_key_prefix[shared_prefix_len];
2512 source_key_prefix.cut(static_cast<key_prefix_size>(shared_prefix_len) + 1U);
2513 add_two_to_empty(source_node_key_byte, source_node, child1_key_byte,
2514 std::move(child1));
2515 }

2643 const auto second_lt = (((keys.integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;

2806 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] find_result find_child(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2807#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2808 const auto replicated_search_key =
2809 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
2810 const auto keys_in_sse_reg =
2811 _mm_cvtsi32_si128(static_cast<std::int32_t>(keys.integer.load()));
2812 const auto matching_key_positions =
2813 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(replicated_search_key, keys_in_sse_reg);
2814 const auto mask = (1U << this->children_count.load()) - 1;
2815 const auto bit_field =
2816 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(matching_key_positions)) & mask;
2817 if (bit_field != 0) {
2818 const auto i = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field));
2819 return std::make_pair(
2820 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
2821 }
2822 return parent_class::child_not_found;
2823#elif defined(__aarch64__)
2824 const auto replicated_search_key =
2825 vdupq_n_u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
2826 const auto keys_in_neon_reg = vreinterpretq_u8_u32(
2827 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
2828 vsetq_lane_u32(keys.integer.load(), vdupq_n_u32(0), 0));
2829 const auto mask = (1ULL << (this->children_count.load() << 3U)) - 1;
2830 const auto matching_key_positions =
2831 vceqq_u8(replicated_search_key, keys_in_neon_reg);
2832 const auto u64_pos_in_vec =
2833 vget_low_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(matching_key_positions));
2834 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
2835 const auto pos_in_scalar = vget_lane_u64(u64_pos_in_vec, 0);
2836 const auto masked_pos = pos_in_scalar & mask;
2837
2838 if (masked_pos == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
2839
2840 const auto i = static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(masked_pos) >> 3U);
2841 return std::make_pair(
2842 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
2843#else // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2844 // Bit twiddling:
2845 // contains_byte: std::countr_zero: for key index:
2846 // 0x80000000 0x1F 3
2847 // 0x800000 0x17 2
2848 // 0x8000 0x0F 1
2849 // 0x80 0x07 0
2850 // 0x0 UB (check!) not found
2851 const auto match = contains_byte(keys.integer, key_byte);
2852 if (match == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
2853
2854 const auto result =
2855 static_cast<typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type>(
2856 std::countr_zero(match) >> 3U);
2857
2858 // The condition could be replaced with masking, but this seems to result
2859 // in a benchmark regression
2860 if (result >= this->children_count.load())
2861 return parent_class::child_not_found;
2862
2863 return std::make_pair(
2864 result,
2865 static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[result]));
2866#endif // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2867 }

2882 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result
2883 begin() noexcept {

2886 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

2892 // TODO(laurynas) The iter_result-returning sequences follow the
2893 // same pattern once child_index is known. Look into extracting a
2894 // small helper method. This might apply to other inode types
2895 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result
2896 last() noexcept {
2897 const auto child_index{
2898 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(this->children_count.load() - 1)};
2899 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
2900 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, child_index,
2901 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

2903
2909 // TODO(laurynas) explore 1) branchless 2) SIMD implementations for
2910 // begin(), last(), next(), prior(), get_key_byte(), and
2911 // lte_key_byte(). next() and begin() will be the most frequently
2912 // invoked methods (assuming forward traversal), so that would be
2913 // the place to start. The GTE and LTE methods are only used by
2914 // seek() so they are relatively rarely invoked. Look at each of the
2915 // inode types when doing this.
2916 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2917 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
2918 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
2919 const auto next_index{static_cast<uint8_t>(child_index + 1)};
2920 if (next_index >= nchildren) return parent_class::end_result;
2921 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
2922 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, next_index,
2923 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2924 }

2931 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2932 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
2933 if (child_index == 0) return parent_class::end_result;
2934 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index - 1)};
2935 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
2936 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, next_index,
2937 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2938 }

2945 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2946 gte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2947 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
2948 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < nchildren; ++i) {
2949 const auto key = keys.byte_array[i].load();
2950 if (key >= key_byte) {
2951 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, i,
2952 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2953 }
2954 }
2955 // This should only occur if there is no entry in the keys[] which
2956 // is greater-than the given [key_byte].
2957 return parent_class::end_result;
2958 }

2965 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2966 lte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2967 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
2968 for (std::int64_t i = children_count_ - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
2969 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
2970 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
2971 if (key <= key_byte) {
2972 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, child_index,
2973 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2974 }
2975 }
2976 // The first key in the node is GT the given key_byte.
2977 return parent_class::end_result;
2978 }

3028 constexpr void add_two_to_empty(std::byte key1, node_ptr child1,
3029 std::byte key2,
3030 db_leaf_unique_ptr child2) noexcept {
3031 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key1 != key2);
3032 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == 2);
3033
3034 const std::uint8_t key1_i = key1 < key2 ? 0U : 1U;
3035 const std::uint8_t key2_i = 1U - key1_i;
3036 keys.byte_array[key1_i] = key1;
3037 children[key1_i] = child1;
3038 keys.byte_array[key2_i] = key2;
3039 children[key2_i] = node_ptr{child2.release(), node_type::LEAF};
3040#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3041 keys.byte_array[2] = unused_key_byte;
3042 keys.byte_array[3] = unused_key_byte;
3043#endif
3044
3045 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3046 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3047 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + this->children_count));
3048 }
3049
3051 constexpr void add_two_to_empty(std::byte key1, node_ptr child1,
3052 std::byte key2, node_ptr child2) noexcept {
3053 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key1 != key2);
3054 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == 2);
3055
3056 const std::uint8_t key1_i = key1 < key2 ? 0U : 1U;
3057 const std::uint8_t key2_i = 1U - key1_i;
3058 keys.byte_array[key1_i] = key1;
3059 children[key1_i] = child1;
3060 keys.byte_array[key2_i] = key2;
3061 children[key2_i] = child2;
3062 // child2 is always a packed value in the value-in-slot path.
3063 // child1 may be an inode (existing subtree) or a packed value.
3064 set_value_bit(key2_i);
3065#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3066 keys.byte_array[2] = unused_key_byte;
3067 keys.byte_array[3] = unused_key_byte;
3068#endif
3069
3070 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3071 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3072 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + this->children_count));
3073 }

3076 union key_union {
3078 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, basic_inode_4::capacity>
3079 byte_array;
3081 critical_section_policy<std::uint32_t> integer;
3082
3084 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26495)
3085 constexpr key_union() noexcept {}
3086 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
3087 };

3090 public:
3091 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
3092 return bitmask_base::test(i);
3093 }
3095 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3096 bitmask_base::set(i);
3097 }
3099 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3100 bitmask_base::clear(i);
3101 }
3102
3104 key_union keys;
3105
3106 static_assert(std::alignment_of_v<decltype(keys)> == 4);
3107 static_assert(sizeof(keys) == 4);

3109 protected:
3111 std::array<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>, basic_inode_4::capacity>
3112 children;
3113
3114 static_assert(sizeof(children) == 32);

3116 private:
3117#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3124 [[nodiscard]] auto get_insert_pos(std::uint8_t insert_key_byte,
3125 unsigned node_key_mask) const noexcept {
3126 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(node_key_mask ==
3127 (1U << this->children_count.load()) - 1);
3128
3129 const auto replicated_insert_key_byte =
3130 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(insert_key_byte));
3131 const auto node_keys_in_sse_reg =
3132 _mm_cvtsi32_si128(static_cast<std::int32_t>(keys.integer.load()));
3133 // Since the existing and insert key values cannot be equal, it's OK to use
3134 // "<=" comparison as "<".
3135 const auto le_node_key_positions =
3136 _mm_cmple_epu8(node_keys_in_sse_reg, replicated_insert_key_byte);
3137 const auto bit_field =
3138 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(le_node_key_positions)) &
3139 node_key_mask;
3140 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::popcount(bit_field));
3141 }
3142#else
3144 static constexpr std::byte unused_key_byte{0xFF};
3145#endif
3146
3147 template <class>
3148 friend class basic_inode_16;
3149 friend class basic_inode_impl<ArtPolicy>;
3150
3151 public:
3162 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
3163 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
3164 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3165 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
3166 tree_depth_type depth,
3167 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
3168 std::uint8_t value_mask = 0) {
3169 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
3170 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 2 && n <= 4);
3171 auto result =
3172 inode4_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
3173 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
3174 auto* node = result.get();
3175 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
3176 node->keys.byte_array[i] = children_span[i].key_byte;
3177 node->children[i] = children_span[i].child;
3178 }
3179#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3180 for (unsigned i = n; i < 4; ++i) node->keys.byte_array[i] = unused_key_byte;
3181#endif
3182 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3183 node->bitmask_base::bits = value_mask;
3184 }
3185 return result;
3186 }
3187 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()
3188}; // class basic_inode_4

3292 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3293 inode4_type& source_node, db_leaf_unique_ptr child,
3294 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3295 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3296 // This overload is only for trees with actual leaves. When
3297 // can_eliminate_leaf is true, init_grow unconditionally sets the
3298 // value bit — which is correct because only the packed-value
3299 // overload below can be called in that mode.
3300 static_assert(!ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf,
3301 "leaf init must not be called when leaves are eliminated");
3302 init_grow(db_instance, source_node,
3303 node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF}, key_byte);
3304 }

3307 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3308 inode4_type& source_node, node_ptr packed_value,
3309 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3310 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3311 init_grow(db_instance, source_node, packed_value, key_byte);
3312 }
3313
3315 constexpr void init_grow(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3316 inode4_type& source_node, node_ptr child_val,
3317 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3318 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3319 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode4_type>(
3320 &source_node, db_instance)};
3321 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
3322
3323#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3324 const auto insert_pos_index = source_node.get_insert_pos(kb, 0xFU);
3325#else
3326 const auto keys_integer = source_node.keys.integer.load();
3327 const auto first_lt = ((keys_integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3328 const auto second_lt = (((keys_integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3329 const auto third_lt = (((keys_integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3330 const auto fourth_lt = (((keys_integer >> 24U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3331 const auto insert_pos_index =
3332 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt + fourth_lt);
3333#endif
3334
3335 unsigned i = 0;
3336 for (; i < insert_pos_index; ++i) {
3337 keys.byte_array[i] = source_node.keys.byte_array[i];
3338 children[i] = source_node.children[i];
3339 }
3340
3341 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i < parent_class::capacity);
3342
3343 keys.byte_array[i] = key_byte;
3344 children[i] = child_val;
3345 ++i;
3346
3347 for (; i <= inode4_type::capacity; ++i) {
3348 keys.byte_array[i] = source_node.keys.byte_array[i - 1];
3349 children[i] = source_node.children[i - 1];
3350 }
3351
3352 // Copy value bitmask from source, inserting the new child's bit.
3353 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3354 for (unsigned j = 0; j < insert_pos_index; ++j) {
3355 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j)))
3356 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j));
3357 }
3358 // The new child at insert_pos_index is a packed value
3359 // (this overload is only called for value-in-slot).
3360 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3361 for (unsigned j = insert_pos_index; j < inode4_type::capacity; ++j) {
3362 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j)))
3363 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j + 1));
3364 }
3365 }
3366 }
3367
3373 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3374 inode48_type& source_node,
3375 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) noexcept {
3376 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3377 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode48_type>(
3378 &source_node, db_instance)};
3379 source_node.remove_child_pointer(child_to_delete, db_instance);
3380 source_node.child_indexes[child_to_delete] = inode48_type::empty_child;
3381
3382 // TODO(laurynas): consider AVX2 gather?
3383 unsigned next_child = 0;
3384 unsigned i = 0;
3385 while (true) {
3386 const auto source_child_i = source_node.child_indexes[i].load();
3387 if (source_child_i != inode48_type::empty_child) {
3388 keys.byte_array[next_child] = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
3389 const auto source_child_ptr =
3390 source_node.children.pointer_array[source_child_i].load();
3391 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(source_child_ptr != nullptr ||
3392 source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(source_child_i));
3393 children[next_child] = source_child_ptr;
3394 ++next_child;
3395 if (next_child == basic_inode_16::capacity) break;
3396 }
3397 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < 255);
3398 ++i;
3399 }
3400
3401 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == basic_inode_16::capacity);
3402 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3403 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3404 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + basic_inode_16::capacity));
3405
3406 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3407 // Copy bitmask from I48. I48 uses slot indices; we mapped them
3408 // to sequential positions in the loop above. Re-scan to set bits.
3409 next_child = 0;
3410 for (unsigned j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
3411 const auto sci = source_node.child_indexes[j].load();
3412 if (sci != inode48_type::empty_child) {
3413 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(sci))
3414 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(next_child));
3415 ++next_child;
3416 if (next_child == basic_inode_16::capacity) break;
3417 }
3418 }
3419 }
3420 }

3430 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
3431 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3432 std::byte key_byte,
3433 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
3434 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
3435 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
3436 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3437 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3438
3439 const auto insert_pos_index =
3440 get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(key_byte);
3441
3442 if (insert_pos_index != children_count_) {
3443 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(insert_pos_index < children_count_);
3444 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] != key_byte);
3445
3446 std::copy_backward(keys.byte_array.cbegin() + insert_pos_index,
3447 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_,
3448 keys.byte_array.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3449 std::copy_backward(children.begin() + insert_pos_index,
3450 children.begin() + children_count_,
3451 children.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3452 }
3453
3454 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
3455 children[insert_pos_index] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
3456 // Shift value bitmask to match shifted children array.
3457 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3458 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3459 }
3460 ++children_count_;
3461 this->children_count = children_count_;
3462
3463 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3464 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3465 }
3466
3468 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
3469 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3470 std::byte key_byte,
3471 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
3472 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
3473 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
3474 const auto insert_pos_index =
3475 get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(key_byte);
3476 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(insert_pos_index < parent_class::capacity);
3477 if (insert_pos_index != children_count_) {
3478 std::copy_backward(keys.byte_array.cbegin() + insert_pos_index,
3479 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_,
3480 keys.byte_array.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3481 std::copy_backward(children.begin() + insert_pos_index,
3482 children.begin() + children_count_,
3483 children.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3484 }
3485 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
3486 children[insert_pos_index] = packed_value;
3487 // Shift existing value bits to match shifted children, then set new bit.
3488 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3489 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3490 ++children_count_;
3491 this->children_count = children_count_;
3492 }

3519 constexpr void remove_child_entry(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3520 auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3521 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_index < children_count_);
3522 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3523 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3524
3525 for (unsigned i = child_index + 1U; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3526 keys.byte_array[i - 1] = keys.byte_array[i];
3527 children[i - 1] = children[i];

3529

3532
3533 // Shift bitmask bits to match shifted children array.
3534 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {

3536 }

3539 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));

3549 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr find_result find_child(
3550 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3551#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3552 const auto replicated_search_key =
3553 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
3554 const auto matching_key_positions =
3555 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(replicated_search_key, keys.byte_vector);
3556 const auto mask = (1U << this->children_count) - 1;
3557 const auto bit_field =
3558 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(matching_key_positions)) & mask;
3559 if (bit_field != 0) {
3560 const auto i = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field));
3561 return std::make_pair(
3562 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3563 }
3564 return parent_class::child_not_found;
3565#elif defined(__aarch64__)
3566 const auto replicated_search_key =
3567 vdupq_n_u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
3568 const auto matching_key_positions =
3569 vceqq_u8(replicated_search_key, keys.byte_vector);
3570 const auto narrowed_positions =
3571 vshrn_n_u16(vreinterpretq_u16_u8(matching_key_positions), 4);
3572 const auto scalar_pos =
3573 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
3574 vget_lane_u64(vreinterpret_u64_u8(narrowed_positions), 0);
3575 const auto child_count = this->children_count.load();
3576 const auto mask = (child_count == 16) ? 0xFFFFFFFF'FFFFFFFFULL
3577 : (1ULL << (child_count << 2U)) - 1;
3578 const auto masked_pos = scalar_pos & mask;
3579
3580 if (masked_pos == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
3581
3582 const auto i = static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(masked_pos) >> 2U);
3583 return std::make_pair(
3584 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3585#else
3586 for (size_t i = 0; i < this->children_count.load(); ++i)
3587 if (key_byte == keys.byte_array[i])
3588 return std::make_pair(
3589 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3590 return parent_class::child_not_found;
3591#endif
3592 }

3599 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr node_ptr get_child(

3608 begin() noexcept {
3609 const auto key = keys.byte_array[0].load();
3610 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, 0,
3611 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

3617 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result
3618 last() noexcept {

3620 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(this->children_count.load() - 1)};
3621 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();

3623 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

3625
3631 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3632 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3633 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
3634 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index + 1)};
3635 if (next_index >= nchildren) return parent_class::end_result;
3636 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3637 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, next_index,
3638 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3639 }
3640
3646 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3647 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3648 if (child_index == 0) return parent_class::end_result;
3649 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index - 1)};
3650 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3651 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, next_index,
3652 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3653 }
3654
3660 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3661 lte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3662 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3663 for (std::int64_t i = children_count_ - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
3664 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
3665 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3666 if (key <= key_byte) {
3667 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, child_index,
3668 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3669 }
3670 }
3671 // The first key in the node is GT the given key_byte.
3672 return parent_class::end_result;
3673 }
3674
3680 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3681 gte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3682 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3683 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3684 const auto key = keys.byte_array[i].load();
3685 if (key >= key_byte) {
3686 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, i,
3687 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3688 }
3689 }
3690 // This should only occur if there is no entry in the keys[] which
3691 // is greater-than the given [key_byte].
3692 return parent_class::end_result;
3693 }

3698 constexpr void delete_subtree(
3699 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
3700 const uint8_t children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3701 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3702 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3703 if (is_value_in_slot(i)) continue;
3704 }
3705 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(children[i], db_instance);
3706 }
3707 }

3713 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
3714 bool recursive) const {
3715 parent_class::dump(os, recursive);
3716 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3717 os << ", key bytes =";
3718 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i)
3719 dump_byte(os, keys.byte_array[i]);
3720 if (recursive) {
3721 os << ", children: \n";
3722 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3723 if (is_value_in_slot(i)) {
3724 os << " [" << static_cast<unsigned>(i) << "] value=";
3725 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3726 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(children[i].load());
3727 }
3728 os << "\n";
3729 } else {
3730 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, children[i].load());
3731 }
3732 }
3733 }
3734 }

3736 private:
3742 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(
3743 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3744 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3745
3746 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < basic_inode_16::capacity);
3747 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3748 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3749 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3750 std::adjacent_find(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3751 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_) >=
3752 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_);
3753
3754#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3755 const auto replicated_insert_key =
3756 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
3757 const auto lesser_key_positions =
3758 _mm_cmple_epu8(replicated_insert_key, keys.byte_vector);
3759 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
3760 const auto bit_field =
3761 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(lesser_key_positions)) & mask;
3762 const auto result =
3763 (bit_field != 0)
3764 ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field))
3765 : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_count_);
3766#else
3767 // This is also the best current ARM implementation
3768 const auto result = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
3769 std::lower_bound(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3770 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_, key_byte) -
3771 keys.byte_array.cbegin());
3772#endif
3773
3774 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3775 result == children_count_ ||
3776 (result < children_count_ && keys.byte_array[result] != key_byte));
3777 return result;
3778 }
3779
3780 protected:
3782 union key_union {
3784 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, basic_inode_16::capacity>
3785 byte_array;
3786#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3788 __m128i byte_vector;
3789#elif defined(__aarch64__)
3791 uint8x16_t byte_vector;
3792#endif
3794 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26495)
3795 key_union() noexcept {}
3796 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
3797 };
3798
3799 public:
3800 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
3801 return bitmask_base::test(i);
3802 }
3803 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3804 bitmask_base::set(i);
3805 }
3806 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3807 bitmask_base::clear(i);
3808 }
3809
3811 key_union keys;
3812
3814 std::array<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>, basic_inode_16::capacity>
3815 children;
3816
3817 private:
3819 static constexpr std::uint8_t empty_child = 0xFF;
3820
3821 template <class>
3822 friend class basic_inode_4;
3823 friend class basic_inode_impl<ArtPolicy>;
3824 template <class>
3825 friend class basic_inode_48;
3826
3827 public:
3832 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
3833 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
3834 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3835 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
3836 tree_depth_type depth,
3837 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
3838 std::uint16_t value_mask = 0) {
3839 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
3840 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 5 && n <= 16);
3841 auto result =
3842 inode16_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
3843 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
3844 auto* node = result.get();
3845 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
3846 node->keys.byte_array[i] = children_span[i].key_byte;
3847 node->children[i] = children_span[i].child;
3848 }
3849 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3850 node->bitmask_base::bits = value_mask;
3851 }
3852 return result;
3853 }
3854 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()
3855}; // class basic_inode_16

3983 constexpr void init_grow(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3984 inode16_type& __restrict source_node,
3985 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3986 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3987 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode16_type>(
3988 &source_node, db_instance)};
3989
3990 std::uint8_t i = 0;
3991 for (; i < inode16_type::capacity; ++i) {
3992 const auto existing_key_byte = source_node.keys.byte_array[i].load();
3993 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(existing_key_byte)] = i;
3994 }
3995 for (i = 0; i < inode16_type::capacity; ++i) {
3996 children.pointer_array[i] = source_node.children[i];
3997 }
3998
3999 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4000 empty_child);
4001 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i == inode16_type::capacity);
4002
4003 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] = i;
4004 children.pointer_array[i] = child_val;
4005 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4006 // Copy bitmask from source I16 (indexed by position).
4007 for (std::uint8_t j = 0; j < inode16_type::capacity; ++j) {
4008 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(j)) set_value_bit_by_ci(j);
4009 }
4010 // The new child is a packed value.
4011 set_value_bit_by_ci(i);
4012 }
4013 for (i = this->children_count; i < basic_inode_48::capacity; i++) {
4014 children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4015 }
4016 }
4017
4023 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26460)
4024 // MSVC C26815 false positive: reclaim objects intentionally destroyed at
4025 // scope exit while db_instance (passed by caller) remains valid.
4026 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
4027 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
4028 inode256_type& __restrict source_node,
4029 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) noexcept {
4030 const auto reclaim_source_node{
4031 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode256_type>(
4032 &source_node, db_instance)};
4033 [[maybe_unused]] const auto r{ArtPolicy::reclaim_if_leaf(
4034 source_node.children[child_to_delete].load(), db_instance)};
4035
4036 source_node.children[child_to_delete] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4037 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4038 source_node.clear_value_bit(child_to_delete);
4039 }
4040
4041 std::uint8_t next_child = 0;
4042 for (unsigned child_i = 0; child_i < 256; child_i++) {
4043 const auto child_ptr = source_node.children[child_i].load();
4044 if (child_ptr == nullptr &&
4045 !(ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
4046 source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_i))))
4047 continue;
4048
4049 child_indexes[child_i] = next_child;
4050 children.pointer_array[next_child] = source_node.children[child_i].load();
4051 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4052 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_i)))
4053 set_value_bit_by_ci(next_child);
4054 }
4055 ++next_child;
4056
4057 if (next_child == basic_inode_48::capacity) return;
4058 }
4059 }
4060 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
4061 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
4062
4071 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
4072 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
4073 std::byte key_byte,
4074 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
4075 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == children_count_);
4076 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ >= parent_class::min_size);
4077 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
4078
4079 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4080 empty_child);
4081 unsigned i{0};
4082#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_SSE4_2
4083 const auto nullptr_vector = _mm_setzero_si128();
4084 while (true) {
4085 const auto ptr_vec0 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i]);
4086 const auto ptr_vec1 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 1]);
4087 const auto ptr_vec2 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 2]);
4088 const auto ptr_vec3 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 3]);
4089 const auto vec0_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec0, nullptr_vector);
4090 const auto vec1_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec1, nullptr_vector);
4091 const auto vec2_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec2, nullptr_vector);
4092 const auto vec3_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec3, nullptr_vector);
4093 // OK to treat 64-bit comparison result as 32-bit vector: we need to find
4094 // the first 0xFF only.
4095 const auto vec01_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec0_cmp, vec1_cmp);
4096 const auto vec23_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec2_cmp, vec3_cmp);
4097 const auto vec_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec01_cmp, vec23_cmp);
4098 const auto cmp_mask =
4099 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(_mm_movemask_epi8(vec_cmp));
4100 if (cmp_mask != 0) {
4101 i = (i << 1U) +
4102 ((static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(cmp_mask)) + 1U) >> 1U);
4103 break;
4104 }
4105 i += 4;
4106 }
4107#elif defined(UNODB_DETAIL_AVX2)
4108 const auto nullptr_vector = _mm256_setzero_si256();
4109 while (true) {
4110 const auto ptr_vec0 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i]);
4111 const auto ptr_vec1 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 1]);
4112 const auto ptr_vec2 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 2]);
4113 const auto ptr_vec3 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 3]);
4114 const auto vec0_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec0, nullptr_vector);
4115 const auto vec1_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec1, nullptr_vector);
4116 const auto vec2_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec2, nullptr_vector);
4117 const auto vec3_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec3, nullptr_vector);
4118 const auto interleaved_vec01_cmp = _mm256_packs_epi32(vec0_cmp, vec1_cmp);
4119 const auto interleaved_vec23_cmp = _mm256_packs_epi32(vec2_cmp, vec3_cmp);
4120 const auto doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp =
4121 _mm256_packs_epi32(interleaved_vec01_cmp, interleaved_vec23_cmp);
4122 if (!_mm256_testz_si256(doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp,
4123 doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp)) {
4124 const auto vec01_cmp =
4125 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec01_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4126 const auto vec23_cmp =
4127 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec23_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4128 const auto interleaved_vec_cmp =
4129 _mm256_packs_epi32(vec01_cmp, vec23_cmp);
4130 const auto vec_cmp =
4131 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4132 const auto cmp_mask =
4133 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(vec_cmp));
4134 i = (i << 2U) +
4135 (static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(cmp_mask)) >> 1U);
4136 break;
4137 }
4138 i += 4;
4139 }
4140#elif defined(__aarch64__)
4141 const auto nullptr_vector = vdupq_n_u64(0);
4142 while (true) {
4143 const auto ptr_vec0 = children.pointer_vector[i];
4144 const auto ptr_vec1 = children.pointer_vector[i + 1];
4145 const auto ptr_vec2 = children.pointer_vector[i + 2];
4146 const auto ptr_vec3 = children.pointer_vector[i + 3];
4147 const auto vec0_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec0);
4148 const auto vec1_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec1);
4149 const auto vec2_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec2);
4150 const auto vec3_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec3);
4151 const auto narrowed_cmp0 = vshrn_n_u64(vec0_cmp, 4);
4152 const auto narrowed_cmp1 = vshrn_n_u64(vec1_cmp, 4);
4153 const auto narrowed_cmp2 = vshrn_n_u64(vec2_cmp, 4);
4154 const auto narrowed_cmp3 = vshrn_n_u64(vec3_cmp, 4);
4155 const auto cmp01 = vcombine_u32(narrowed_cmp0, narrowed_cmp1);
4156 const auto cmp23 = vcombine_u32(narrowed_cmp2, narrowed_cmp3);
4157 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4158 const auto narrowed_cmp01 = vshrn_n_u32(cmp01, 4);
4159 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4160 const auto narrowed_cmp23 = vshrn_n_u32(cmp23, 4);
4161 const auto cmp = vcombine_u16(narrowed_cmp01, narrowed_cmp23);
4162 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4163 const auto narrowed_cmp = vshrn_n_u16(cmp, 4);
4164 const auto scalar_pos =
4165 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4166 vget_lane_u64(vreinterpret_u64_u8(narrowed_cmp), 0);
4167 if (scalar_pos != 0) {
4168 i = (i << 1U) +
4169 static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(scalar_pos) >> 3U);
4170 break;
4171 }
4172 i += 4;
4173 }
4174#else // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
4175 node_ptr child_ptr;
4176 while (true) {
4177 child_ptr = children.pointer_array[i];
4178 if (child_ptr == nullptr) break;
4179 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < 255);
4180 ++i;
4181 }
4182#endif // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
4183
4184 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i < parent_class::capacity);
4185
4186#ifndef NDEBUG
4187 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[i] == nullptr);
4188 for (unsigned j = 0; j < i; ++j)
4189 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[j] != nullptr);
4190#endif
4191
4192 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
4193 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4194 children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
4195 this->children_count = children_count_ + 1U;
4196 }
4197
4199 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
4200 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
4201 std::byte key_byte,
4202 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
4203 // Reuse the leaf overload by wrapping the packed value in a
4204 // temporary unique_ptr that immediately releases. This avoids
4205 // duplicating the SIMD slot-finding logic.
4206 // TODO(#707): refactor to share slot-finding code without this hack.
4207 std::ignore = children_count_;
4208 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4209 empty_child);
4210 // Find first empty slot (not occupied by pointer or VIS value).
4211 unsigned slot = 0;
4212 while (children.pointer_array[slot] != nullptr ||
4213 is_value_in_slot_by_ci(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(slot))) {
4214 ++slot;
4215 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(slot < parent_class::capacity);
4216 }
4217 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(slot < 48);
4218 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
4219 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(slot);
4220 children.pointer_array[slot] = packed_value;
4221 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
4222 this->children_count = this->children_count + 1U;
4223 }
4224
4229 constexpr void remove(
4230 std::uint8_t child_index,
4231 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
4232 remove_child_pointer(child_index, db_instance);
4233 remove_child_entry(child_index);
4234 }
4235
4239 constexpr void remove_child_entry(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4240 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4241 clear_value_bit(child_index);
4242 }
4243 children.pointer_array[child_indexes[child_index]] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4244 child_indexes[child_index] = empty_child;
4245 --this->children_count;
4246 }
4247
4253 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::find_result
4254 find_child(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
4255 const auto child_i =
4256 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)].load();
4257 if (child_i != empty_child) {
4258 return std::make_pair(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte),
4259 &children.pointer_array[child_i]);
4260 }
4261 return parent_class::child_not_found;
4262 }
4263
4272 // N48: This is the case where we need to indirect through child_indices.
4273 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr node_ptr get_child(
4274 std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4275 const auto child_i = child_indexes[child_index].load();
4276 // In a data race, the child_indices[] can be concurrently
4277 // modified, which will cause the OLC version tag to get
4278 // bumped. However, we are in the middle of reading and acting on
4279 // the data while that happens. This can cause the value stored
4280 // in child_indices[] at our desired child_index to be empty_child
4281 // (0xFF). In this circumstance, the caller will correctly detect
4282 // a problem when they do read_critical_section::check(), but we
4283 // will have still indirected beyond the end of the allocation and
4284 // ASAN can fail us. To prevent that and read only the data that
4285 // is legally allocated to the node, we return nullptr in this
4286 // case and rely on the caller to detect a problem when they call
4287 // read_critical_section::check().
4288 return UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(child_i == empty_child)
4289 ? node_ptr() // aka nullptr
4290 : children.pointer_array[child_i].load();
4291 }
4292
4298 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::iter_result
4299 begin() noexcept {
4300 for (std::uint64_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
4301 // cppcheck-suppress useStlAlgorithm
4302 if (child_indexes[i] != empty_child) {
4303 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
4304 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4305 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I48}, key, child_index,
4306 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};
4307 }
4308 }
4309 // because we always have at least 17 keys.
4310 UNODB_DETAIL_CANNOT_HAPPEN(); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
4311 }
4312
4318 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::iter_result
4319 last() noexcept {
4320 for (std::int64_t i = 255; i >= 0; i--) {
4321 if (child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i)] != empty_child) {
4322 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
4323 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4324 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I48}, key, child_index,
4325 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};
4326 }
4327 }
4328 // because we always have at least 17 keys.
4329 UNODB_DETAIL_CANNOT_HAPPEN(); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
4330 }
4331
4337 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::iter_result_opt
4338 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4339 // loop over the remaining byte values in lexical order.
4340 for (auto i = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(child_index) + 1; i < 256; i++) {
4341 // cppcheck-suppress useStlAlgorithm
4342 if (child_indexes[i] != empty_child) {
4343 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
4344 const auto next_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4345 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I48}, key, next_index,
4346 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
4347 }
4348 }
4349 return parent_class::end_result;
4350 }
4351
4357 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::iter_result_opt
4358 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4359 // loop over the prior byte values in lexical order.

4361 if (child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i)] != empty_child) {
4362 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
4363 const auto next_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4364 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I48}, key, next_index,
4365 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
4366 }
4367 }
4368 return parent_class::end_result;

4654 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
4655 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
4656 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
4657 tree_depth_type depth,
4658 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
4659 const std::array<std::uint8_t, 6>& value_mask = {}) {
4660 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
4661 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 17 && n <= 48);
4662 auto result =
4663 inode48_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
4664 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
4665 auto* node = result.get();
4666 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
4667 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_span[i].key_byte);
4668 node->child_indexes[kb] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4669 node->children.pointer_array[i] = children_span[i].child;
4670 }
4671 for (unsigned i = n; i < 48; ++i) {
4672 node->children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4673 }
4674 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4675 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value_mask.size(); ++i) {
4676 node->bitmask_base::bits[i] = value_mask[i];
4677 }
4678 }
4679 return result;
4680 }

4792 constexpr void init_grow(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
4793 inode48_type& __restrict source_node,
4794 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
4795 const auto reclaim_source_node{
4796 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode48_type>(
4797 &source_node, db_instance)};
4798 unsigned children_copied = 0;
4799 unsigned i = 0;
4800 while (true) {
4801 const auto children_i = source_node.child_indexes[i].load();
4802 if (children_i == inode48_type::empty_child) {
4803 children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4804 } else {
4805 children[i] = source_node.children.pointer_array[children_i].load();
4806 ++children_copied;
4807 if (children_copied == inode48_type::capacity) break;
4808 }
4809 ++i;
4810 }
4811
4812 ++i;
4813 for (; i < basic_inode_256::capacity; ++i) children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4814
4815 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4816 nullptr);
4817 children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] = child_val;
4818 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4819 // Copy bitmask from source I48. I48 indexes by slot position,
4820 // I256 indexes by key byte. Map through child_indexes.
4821 for (unsigned j = 0; j < 256; ++j) {
4822 const auto ci = source_node.child_indexes[j].load();
4823 if (ci != inode48_type::empty_child &&
4824 source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(ci)) {
4825 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j));
4826 }
4827 }
4828 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
4829 }
4830 }

4971 next(const std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4972 // loop over the remaining byte values in lexical order.
4973 for (auto i = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(child_index) + 1;
4974 i < basic_inode_256::capacity; i++) {
4975 // cppcheck-suppress useStlAlgorithm
4976 if (children[i] != nullptr ||
4977 this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) {
4978 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
4979 const auto next_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4980 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I256}, key, next_index,
4981 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
4982 }
4983 }
4984 return parent_class::end_result;
4985 }

4992 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_256::iter_result_opt
4993 prior(const std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4994 // loop over the remaining byte values in lexical order.
4995 for (auto i = static_cast<std::int64_t>(child_index) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
4996 const auto next_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4997 if (children[next_index] != nullptr ||
4998 this->is_value_in_slot(next_index)) {
4999 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
5000 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I256}, key, next_index,
5001 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
5002 }
5003 }
5004 return parent_class::end_result;
5005 }

5052 // TODO(laurynas) Lifting this out might help with iterator and
5053 // lambda patterns.
5054 template <typename Function>
5055 constexpr void for_each_child(Function func) const
5056 noexcept(noexcept(func(0, node_ptr{nullptr}))) {
5057#ifndef NDEBUG
5058 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
5059 std::uint8_t actual_children_count = 0;
5060#endif
5061
5062 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
5063 const auto child_ptr = children[i].load();
5064 if (child_ptr != nullptr ||
5065 (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
5066 this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i)))) {
5067 func(i, child_ptr);
5068#ifndef NDEBUG
5069 ++actual_children_count;
5070 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count <= children_count_ ||
5071 children_count_ == 0);
5072#endif
5073 }
5074 }
5075 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count == children_count_);
5076 }
5077
5081 constexpr void delete_subtree(
5082 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
5083 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5084 for_each_child([this, &db_instance](unsigned i, node_ptr child) noexcept {
5085 if (this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) return;
5086 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(child, db_instance);
5087 });
5088 } else {
5089 for_each_child(
5090 [&db_instance]([[maybe_unused]] unsigned i, node_ptr child) noexcept {
5091 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(child, db_instance);
5092 });
5093 }
5094 }

5100 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
5101 bool recursive) const {
5102 parent_class::dump(os, recursive);
5103 os << ", key bytes & children:\n";
5104 for_each_child([&os, recursive, this](unsigned i, node_ptr child) {
5105 os << ' ';
5106 dump_byte(os, static_cast<std::byte>(i));
5107 os << ' ';
5108 if (recursive) {
5109 if (is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) {
5110 os << "value=";
5111 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5112 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(child);
5113 }
5114 os << "\n";
5115 } else {
5116 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, child);
5117 }
5118 }
5119 });
5120 }

5141 public:
5146 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
5147 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
5148 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
5149 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
5150 tree_depth_type depth,
5151 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
5152 const std::array<std::uint8_t, 32>& value_mask = {}) {
5153 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
5154 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 49 && n <= 256);
5155 auto result =
5156 parent_class::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
5157 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
5158 auto* node = result.get();
5159 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
5160 node->children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
5161 }
5162 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
5163 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_span[i].key_byte);
5164 node->children[kb] = children_span[i].child;
5165 }
5166 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5167 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value_mask.size(); ++i) {
5168 node->bitmask_base::bits[i] = value_mask[i];
5169 }
5170 }
5171 return result;
5172 }
5173 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()

5176// ─── Bulk Load: build_chain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
5177
5178UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
5179UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(4459)
5180
5181template <class ArtPolicy>
5182[[nodiscard]] typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr bulk_build_chain(
5183 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST typename ArtPolicy::db_type& self,
5184 typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type k, typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr child,
5185 tree_depth<typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type> start_depth) {
5186 using node_ptr = typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr;
5187 using inode_4 = typename ArtPolicy::inode4_type;
5188 using tree_depth_type = tree_depth<typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type>;
5189 constexpr std::size_t cap = key_prefix_capacity;
5190 const auto full_key = k.get_key_view();
5191 const auto key_len = k.size();
5192 const auto start = static_cast<std::size_t>(start_depth);
5193 auto current = child;
5194 bool child_is_value = ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf;
5195 bool owns_current = false;
5196 try {
5197 std::size_t pos = key_len;
5198 while (pos > start + cap) {
5199 const auto depth = pos - cap - 1;
5200 const auto dispatch = full_key[pos - 1];
5201 auto remaining = k;
5202 remaining.shift_right(depth);
5203 auto chain{
5204 inode_4::create(self, full_key, remaining,
5205 tree_depth_type{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(depth)},
5206 dispatch, current)};
5207 if (child_is_value) {
5208 chain->set_value_bit(0);
5209 child_is_value = false;
5210 }
5211 current = node_ptr{chain.release(), node_type::I4};
5212 owns_current = true;
5213#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
5214 self.template account_growing_inode<node_type::I4>();
5215#endif
5216 pos = depth;
5217 }
5218 if (pos > start) {
5219 const auto dispatch = full_key[pos - 1];
5220 auto chain{inode_4::create(
5221 self, full_key, tree_depth_type{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(start)},
5222 static_cast<key_prefix_size>(pos - start - 1), dispatch, current)};
5223 if (child_is_value) {
5224 chain->set_value_bit(0);
5225 }
5226 current = node_ptr{chain.release(), node_type::I4};
5227#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
5228 self.template account_growing_inode<node_type::I4>();
5229#endif
5230 }
5231 return current;
5232 } catch (...) {
5233 if (owns_current) {
5234 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(current, self);
5235 } else if (!child_is_value) {
5236 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(current, self);
5237 }
5238 throw;
5239 }
5240}
